mapper.insert: INSERT INTO APPROVAL_DEPUTY (PRINCIPAL_EMP_NO, DEPUTY_EMP_NO, START_DATE, END_DATE, REASON, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{principalEmpNo}, #{deputyEmpNo}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE APPROVAL_DEPUTY SET CANCELLED_AT = #{now}, CANCELLED_BY = #{by,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE DEPUTY_ID = #{id} AND CANCELLED_AT IS NULL
